13291.text:
13291 * savēla 'in time, early'. [Semant. cf. sakāla-,
*savāra-. — sa-², vḗlā- ] S. savera f. 'an early hour', adj. 'early' = savero (forms with - l -, savela f., savelo ← L.); L. savēl , °lē adv. 'early', awāṇ. savēl , °lā adj., °lē 'in the morning',
poṭh. savelā 'good'; P. savel , saver f. 'morning, dawn', savelā , saverā 'early, in good time', °le , °re adv.; Ku. N. saber 'early in the morning' (- b - < emph. - vv - or
more prob. from simplex ber ); H. sawerā m. 'early
morning'; G. saveḷā , saverā adv., M. saver (a lw. ac. to
LM 416, but see vḗlā- ).
